input.subject: Selling my late mother's apartment - 245 E 79th St
input.bodyText:
Hello,

I got your name from the doorman at the building. My mother passed earlier this year and I'm the executor of her estate. We need to sell her co-op at 245 E 79th St, apartment 11C. It's a 2-bedroom, roughly 1,100 square feet, needs updating.

I live out of state so I'd need an agent who can really handle everything - the board package, showings, cleanout coordination. Can you tell me how you'd approach it and what your commission is?

Regards,
Diane Kessler-Roth
